catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class starts a continuous, unitless picomotor jog. cap.motion.joint_velocity.v1 requires a duration and joint velocities in rad/s, and cap.motion.joint_position.v1 requires target positions in rad; the clone's VA/MV commands take a native velocity and a direction and have no position or duration semantics.

notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card helper PythonObjectDriver was not usable because the upstream Controller builds every wire command at run time in parse_command ('1><axis> <command> <parameter>\r'); the package is a direct Driver over picomotor_terminal_based:Controller with a native.py factory. Recon confirmed both card entry symbols at line 60 and selected the terminal variant because it does not import PyQt5. The driver is R1 (small open-loop picomotor motion); the model-authored, unreviewed package was exercised on the fake backend only, and the hardware path in native.py was never imported or run. At R1 the SDK loader does not refuse an unreviewed hardware backend, so this package claims no such protection. The fake is an in-memory command handler with placeholder state; it does not model motion timing or position, and its start values are test data. The optional deceleration field of cap.motion.stop.v1 is accepted and ignored because the 8742 ST command has no deceleration setting and no text file states a deceleration bound. NOT COVERED: absolute or relative position moves, position readback, and closed-loop travel limits; the clone demonstrates only velocity/direction jogging and the MD? motion-done query. The gate passed with no warnings on G1-G9 (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level).
